cast: Lily (girl, 9), her little brother Tom (6), Mum, Dad, Grandma, Grandpa, Aunt Kate, Uncle Ben, cousin Sam (10) and the puppy Max. Relationship words are always shown with these same people, so the picture tells who is who.

words.sz: Kate 姑姑是爸爸的妹妹。
words.scene: Aunt Kate hugging Lily at the front door, both smiling, a suitcase beside her because she has come to visit.
more: Lily's aunt gives her a book.
Lily 的姑姑送她一本书。

words.scene: Tom standing and waving hello with a big grin, holding a toy aeroplane.
more: There are ten boys in my class.

words.scene: Two brothers who look alike, a big boy of about ten carrying his little brother of about five on his back, both laughing.
more: My brother is six years old.
Tom 是 Lily 的弟弟。

words.en: The child is playing with blocks.
words.scene: One small child of about four sitting on a rug building a tower of colourful wooden blocks.
more: 每个孩子都有一块蛋糕。

words.zh: 堂兄弟姐妹；表兄弟姐妹
words.sz: Sam 是 Lily 的表哥。
words.scene: Lily and her cousin Sam playing a board game at a family party, Aunt Kate and Uncle Ben smiling behind them, balloons in the room.
more: My cousin is ten years old.
Lily plays with her cousin at the party.
Lily 在聚会上和表哥一起玩。

words.scene: Dad carrying Lily on his shoulders in the park, both laughing.
more: My dad works in a bank.

words.en: Lily is Mum and Dad's daughter.
words.sz: Lily 是爸爸妈妈的女儿。
words.scene: A mother gently brushing her little daughter's long hair in front of a mirror, both smiling.
more: They have one son and one daughter.
他们有一个儿子和一个女儿。

words.scene: Lily's whole family squeezed happily together on the sofa for a family photo: Grandma, Grandpa, Mum, Dad, Lily, Tom and Max.
more: There are five people in my family.

words.en: My father teaches me to ride a bike.
words.scene: Dad running beside Lily and holding the back of her bicycle seat as she learns to ride.

words.sz: Mia 是 Lily 最好的朋友。
words.scene: Lily and her best friend, a girl with black hair in two buns and a pink dress, walking arm in arm in the school playground, laughing.
more: Lily plays with her friend after school.
Lily 放学后和朋友一起玩。

words.en: The man at the shop is very friendly.
words.sz: 商店里的那个人很友善。
words.scene: A friendly smiling postman with a mail bag waving hello to Lily and Max at the garden gate.
more: Our new teacher is very friendly.

words.scene: Lily standing and waving hello with a big smile.
more: There are twelve girls in my class.

words.sz: 爷爷抱着刚出生的孙子。
words.scene: Grandpa proudly holding his tiny baby grandchild wrapped in a soft yellow blanket.
more: Lily 是爷爷的第一个孙辈。

words.scene: Grandpa and Lily sitting on a small wooden pier fishing together on a calm lake.
more: My grandad is seventy years old.

words.scene: Grandma and her granddaughter Lily picking flowers together in Grandma's garden.
more: 他们的孙女每个星期天都来看望。

words.scene: Grandpa sitting in a big armchair telling a story with his arms wide, Lily and Tom sitting on the rug listening.
more: My grandfather lives on a farm.

words.scene: Grandma baking with Lily in a cosy kitchen, both stirring a big mixing bowl, flour on their noses.

words.en: My grandmother makes me a scarf.
words.sz: 我奶奶给我做了一条围巾。
words.scene: Grandma sitting in a rocking chair knitting a long red scarf, a ball of wool on her lap.
more: Lily's grandmother lives near the sea.

words.scene: Grandpa watering red tomato plants in his vegetable garden with Tom helping.

words.en: Lily visits her grandparents on Sunday.
words.sz: Lily 星期天去看爷爷奶奶。
words.scene: Grandma and Grandpa sitting side by side on a park bench holding hands and smiling.
more: A grandparent is your mum's or dad's parent.
祖父母是你爸爸或妈妈的父母。
My grandparents live in the country.

words.scene: Grandpa and his grandson Tom flying a colourful kite together on a windy hill.

words.en: Granny gives me a big kiss.
words.scene: Grandma giving Lily a big warm hug at her front door, little hearts around them.
A group of five children standing close together in a circle, holding hands and smiling.
more: Work in a group of four.
A group of children are playing in the park.

words.en: We have a guest for dinner.
words.scene: Lily opening the front door to welcome a guest: a grown-up woman of about forty, tall with adult proportions, smiling and holding a bunch of flowers and a wrapped present.
more: We have a guest from Spain.
我们有一位从西班牙来的客人。
The guest sits next to Grandma.

words.scene: A cool friendly grown-up young man of about twenty-five, tall with adult proportions and a short beard, wearing a baseball cap and a hoodie, giving a thumbs up, a skateboard under his arm.
more: Tom's uncle is a funny guy.
Tom 的叔叔是个有趣的人。
Who is that guy with the dog?

words.scene: A smiling groom in a suit gently putting a wedding ring on his bride's finger, the groom in the front.
more: Aunt Kate's husband is Uncle Ben.
Kate 姑姑的丈夫是 Ben 叔叔。

words.scene: Lily hugging Max tightly with her eyes closed, little red hearts floating around them.
A just-married grown-up couple in their thirties, tall with adult proportions, a bride in white and a groom in a suit, walking out under falling flower petals and waving.
Lily sitting on her bed holding a framed photo of Grandma, smiling a little sadly as she misses her.
more: Hurry up! Don't miss the bus.

words.en: My mother walks me to school.
words.scene: Mum holding Lily's hand as they walk to school together on a sunny morning, Lily wearing a school bag.

words.sz: 布朗先生是我们的老师。
words.scene: A polite grown-up gentleman of about fifty, tall and slim with adult proportions and a grey moustache, in a smart suit, lifting his bowler hat to say hello.
more: 史密斯先生是我们的邻居。

words.scene: A smiling married lady wearing a sun hat and a flowery dress, waving from her front garden, a wedding ring on her hand.
more: Mrs Brown has a big dog.

words.en: Ms White is the head teacher.
words.scene: A confident woman in a smart blazer holding a folder, smiling warmly in a school corridor.
Mum sitting on Lily's bed reading her a bedtime story, Lily tucked in under the blanket.
more: My mum cooks dinner every day.

words.en: Our neighbour has a big garden.
words.sz: 我们的邻居有一个大花园。
words.scene: Lily waving over the low garden fence to a kind old man in the next garden, two houses side by side.
more: 我们的邻居养了一只猫。

words.scene: Mum and Dad each holding one of Lily's hands and swinging her up between them in the park.
more: 每个父母都爱自己的孩子。
Lily's parents work in a hospital.
Lily 的父母在医院工作。

words.en: Lily writes to her penfriend in Spain.
words.sz: Lily 给她在西班牙的笔友写信。
words.scene: Lily at her desk happily reading a letter from far away, an envelope with colourful stamps and a small world map with a heart drawn on another country, no writing.
more: Lily sends a photo to her penfriend.
Lily 给笔友寄了一张照片。

words.en: My sister is older than me.
words.scene: Two sisters who look alike, a big girl of about twelve hugging her little sister of about six, both with pigtails and smiling.
more: My sister is nine years old.
Tom has a sister called Lily.

words.en: Tom is Mum and Dad's son.
words.sz: Tom 是爸爸妈妈的儿子。
words.scene: A father and his little son fishing side by side on a riverbank, the son proudly holding up a small fish.
more: They have a son and a daughter.
他们有一个儿子和一个女儿。

words.scene: A big family tree drawn as a real tree, with little round portraits of grandparents, parents and children hanging on its branches, no writing.
more: Write your name and surname here.
在这里写下你的名字和姓。

words.scene: A cheerful teenage girl of about fifteen with headphones around her neck and a backpack, holding a phone and smiling.
more: A teenager is between thirteen and nineteen.
青少年是十三到十九岁的人。
Lily's cousin is a teenager now.
Lily 的表姐现在是青少年了。

words.scene: Uncle Ben lifting Tom high up into the air, both laughing.
more: My uncle has a big car.
Uncle Ben plays football with us.
Ben 叔叔和我们一起踢足球。

words.scene: A smiling grown-up woman of about thirty, tall with adult proportions, in a white wedding dress holding a bouquet of flowers, her grown-up husband in a suit standing a little behind her.
more: Uncle Ben's wife is Aunt Kate.
Ben 叔叔的妻子是 Kate 姑姑。
